entities.summary: Michalis Antonis "Mike" Bramos, born 27 May 1987, is a Greek-American former professional basketball player. Born in Harper Woods, Michigan, he played college basketball for Miami University. In his senior season at Miami, Bramos was named MAC Player of the Year. He is a shooting guard-small forward, standing at 1.98 m, with a 2.13 m (7 ft.) wingspan.
